messages:
Elena (CSM): Ok team — ZephyrCorp dedicated bring-up kickoff. Need to lock quotas + autoscale policy and confirm Friday load test window 2026-03-27 09:00 PST. Key asks: burst profile, warmup steps, KMS rollout timing, canary fallback model. @Michael C can you confirm headroom? @Rajiv can SRE run smoke + chaos probe?
Michael C: We have 48 GPUs reserved in their pool. For the workload they sent, target steady QPS ~1200, planned burst to ~2500 for ~10m. My initial proposal: min_instances=6, max_instances=60, scale based on p95 latency and queue depth. Will validate mem/slot sizing by EOD.
Rajiv (SRE): SRE can run the smoke + targeted chaos. Proposed ramp: 200 -> 1200 over 30m, hold 1h, then burst to 2500 for 10m. Also plan a node drain during the soak to validate fallback. I need the load script and auth token.
Anya - Eng-Infra: putting the k6 snippet here for the burst profile — tweak VUs and duration as needed:
```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/generate', JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'test' }), { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer $LOAD_TOKEN' }});
  sleep(0.2); // ~5 rps per VU
}
```
Run with: `k6 run --vus 300 --duration 30m script.js` then jump to `--vus 600` for the 10m burst.
OpsBot: Quota change request created: Q-78934 (owner: Michael C) — link: https://redwood.ops/quotas/Q-78934 :bell:
Michael C: Note on caching/warmup — enable prefix KV caching and pre-prime top-10 prompts for first 2 hours to avoid cold-start p95 spikes. I'll flip the switch right before test start. Also confirm KMS key rotation is scheduled outside the window.
Tomas (SRE Lead): We'll wire up alerting: tokenized cost spike, p95 > 500ms for 5m, and error rate >1% triggers paging. Fallback plan: route to amber-1 model (smaller) if p95 > 700ms across 3 consecutive 1m windows.
Elena (CSM): Add enablement: customer runbook walkthrough on Wed 15:00 PST — invite sent to Zephyr onboarding and support. Also capture feedback on model quality during soak. If go-live experiences >48h of degraded perf we'll tag renewal-risk and escalate.
Rajiv (SRE): Scheduling note: will run chaos drain during the 1h hold at +40m mark. Will post slack alert 10m before.
Anya - Eng-Infra: I'll deploy the autoscale policy to staging first and share the exact YAML here for quick review. Quick preview: `policy: cpu_based: false; metric: p95_latency; window: 30s; scale_up: 2x; cool_down: 60s`
Michael C: thumbs up. I'll verify GPU headroom and the instance sizing matrix.
Elena (CSM): Great — summary action items: (1) Michael confirm sizing + enable prefix cache (2) Anya push autoscale policy to staging + YAML (3) Rajiv schedule and run smoke + chaos (4) Tomas wire alerts + fallback (5) OpsBot track Q-78934 and KMS timing. Meeting to validate dry run Thursday 09:00 PST. :thumbsup:
Tomas (SRE Lead): Acknowledged. I'll attach the alert deck after initial smoke.
Elena (CSM): Thanks all — let's keep updates in this thread.
__note: This thread is a compact Slack conversation for a dedicated-capacity bring-up (quota planning, autoscaling, load tests, enablement). Messages are presented in chronological order and prefixed with sender names as required.
